name: intrusion_door_tamper
title: Restricted-zone entry, forced door, then a covered camera
description: Scripted DEMO on the first camera and its first zone: a restricted-zone entry, an access-control 'door forced' report 8 s later (grouped into the same alert and incident), a camera cover at 15 s that the health monitor detects, and recovery at 30 s. Every event is labelled DEMO and excluded from precision, baselines and hotspots.

steps.observation: Person-sized track entered the restricted zone (scripted)
